messages:
noah: opened a small PR to clarify how Retry-After can appear in streaming scenarios (initial header vs trailers) and how that interacts with context trimming. added tiny node/python snippets and a micro repro harness. PTAL :wave:

ellie: link? want to check the wording around trailers — some infra doesn't surface trailers to clients. we should say what SDKs will likely see.

noah: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/933. Added note: some proxies drop trailers -> SDKs will often only see stream abort + no header, so we recommend emitting a short closing event with a resume cursor when possible.

sam: can you paste the short closing event pattern? want to ensure it matches existing event schema.

noah: pasted in PR but pasted inline here: ```json
{"type":"stream_close","reason":"overload","resume_cursor":"abc123","hint":"retry-after=5"}
```

ellie: nice. please clarify that the resume_cursor is opaque and might map to KV-cache offsets, not token indexes. also add a tiny endian note: cursor monotonicity is important.

noah: added paragraph: "cursor semantics: opaque string, monotonic per-session, can represent KV offsets not token idx. do not assume numeric token IDs."

sam: ops asked for a short paragraph about context trimming: if server trims prefix to fit context, resuming may produce missing earlier context — recommend checkpointing application-level commit points (not raw token positions).

noah: added guidance: "Checkpoint application commit points (message ids or turn ids) rather than raw token offsets to avoid mismatch after server-side trimming." with an example pattern and tiny node snippet showing an idempotent tail.

docs-bot: CI started for PR #933  link: https://ci.internal.redwood/1412.

omar: editorial: use code spans for header names (`Retry-After`, `x-resume-cursor`) and add a one-line deployment difference: Dedicated may enqueue rather than return immediate 429s.

noah: updated header formatting and added 'Deployment differences' bullet linking to dedicated docs. also added a :warning: about token duplication and billing.

ellie: small technical nit: include a brief note about what to do if trailers are not delivered: prefer explicit end-event with resume cursor or place resume cursor in the last chunk's metadata field, because some clients see only chunks.

noah: added both options and a tiny pseudo-snippet showing checking chunk.metadata.cursor. Also added migration blurb: "If your SDK auto-reconnects streams, provide an explicit resume API and document how to pass resume_cursor."

sam: LGTM from ops perspective. leaving final copy to ellie.

ellie: did a quick pass, tightened wording, fixed grammar. merge after CI passes. :shipit:

docs-bot: PR #933 merged by ellie at 1798881302.
